text: The Irish economy is projected to grow at a slower but still robust pace, facing near-term headwinds from the war in the Middle East. MDD is projected to grow by about 2½ percent in 2026–27, moderating from 4.9 percent in 2025. Real GDP is projected to decline by about 1 percent this year and rebound by 3.7 percent in 2027, while headline inflation rises to 3½ percent this year. Staff judge that significant uncertainty remains, with risks to the growth outlook on the downside and to inflation on the upside.
